name: Balduinstein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of red with a white cross throughout, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Balduinstein (a red cross on white with a yellow quarter).
history: Municipal flag of Balduinstein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Balduinstein arms — cross with yellow quarter
